error: The page's population line says all orders; every figure is over delivered orders.
warning_texts: release/report.md line 3 describes the population as every order in the period, which includes cancelled and pending orders; a reader who takes it at face value would think the 35,741.52 headline covers 200 orders rather than the 174 delivered ones.

Both release gates passed a page that misstates its own population: caveats_rendered only confirms each registered caveat string appears somewhere on the surface, and nothing in audit/check_plan.json checks the population or period wording a surface prints, so that wording is checked by auditor judg

audit/check_plan.json lists gate_release_document claims_rendered and caveats_rendered under accepted_unproven (the plan proof crashed with FileNotFoundError), so the only document-level rules on this stage were never shown to fire on a broken release.

audit/audit_spec.yaml sets the period end to 2025-03-30 while the spec calls it the reported quarter and calculated_metrics.json names the period 2025-Q1-delivered; the raw export has no delivered order on 2025-03-31, so no figure changes, but a human should confirm the 89-day window is intended.

metrics/calculated_metrics.json writes the country formula as SUM(net_amount) WHERE country = country, which is a tautology as text; the values are correct against raw, but the formula string does not say which country each metric selects.
summary: All 21 shown numbers (7 render roles, 5 claims, 3 surfaces) recompute exactly from raw_data/orders.csv and country figures visibly sum to net_revenue, but release/report.md line 3 states the population as all orders inside the period, contradicting the spec population (delivered orders inside the period) and the page's own caveats; neither release gate reads that sentence, so it passed both.
